messages:
Ashley: Hey support — AcmeCorp tenant (tenant_id: acme-9876) just got a promo code applied but it's showing under Hosted: HOSTED_BASIC instead of Dedicated: dedicated-reserved-8x. Provisioning for their reserved contract failed when we tried to spin up capacity. Anyone seen this?
Ben: I can see the grant in the ledger: grant_0a12b3c applied to acme-9876 but product_code=HOSTED_BASIC. Digging into promo-engine logs now.
support-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-321 and notified billing/ops.
Priya: Confirming — PROMO-ACME-24 was applied and the promo entry default_product is HOSTED_BASIC. We can reassign but need an audit note and the grant id.
Ashley: Grant id is grant_0a12b3c. Customer expects dedicated-reserved-8x (they have a reserved contract and PO PO-7721). Repro steps: POST /v1/promos/apply {"tenant":"acme-9876","code":"PROMO-ACME-24"} returns 200 but tenant.product shows HOSTED_BASIC.
Ben: Looks like promo-engine falls back to default_product when tenant flag sku_eligibility is missing. This tenant's sku_eligibility tag was dropped during the onboarding migration. I'm going to re-add the flag.
Ben: Running: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/tenants/acme-9876/flags -H 'Authorization: internal-token' -d '{"sku_eligibility":"dedicated"}'```
Priya: Once the flag is set I can run the reassign job against grant_0a12b3c. Adding audit note: "customer_reserved_contract_present: PO-7721, requestor: Ashley"
Ben: Flag applied.
Priya: Reassign job executed -> grant_0a12b3c now mapped to product=dedicated-reserved-8x. Updated billing ledger and tenant view. Notifying ops to resume provisioning.
Ashley: I see tenant status moved to provisioning -> creating. Thanks team. Can someone follow up with eng-infra on why the migration cleared sku_eligibility? We should add a guard so promo-engine checks existing reserved_contracts before falling back.
Ben: Filing follow-up in eng-infra with repro logs and the migration batch id.
Priya: Closing INC-2026-321 after customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
